zh.explain: 由失意变为得意时，像龙吟虎啸一样，高歌腾跃都适宜。蓝天之下自然有直通云霄之路，得到功名也只是早晚的事。
divination: 得此签者，让去就去，叫停就停。行动举止遵循对方的意愿，自然通达顺畅，到头来也必定会有好的结果。
items: 勇敢面对困境，危机就是转机。
zh.summary: 此卦龙吟虎啸之象。所祈求之事能顺从自己的意愿而有望成功。

verse: The dragon’s song will blend with the tiger’s roar.
A thoroughfare cuts through the clear blue sky,
It’s time for one to gather fame once more.
interpretation: Let go of what needs to go, keep what needs to be kept.  Follow what is destined, you will understand and assimilate for your own use to pave your own path to success.
meaning: When the dragon calls or the tiger roars, there is hope that things will proceed as planned.
en.explain: When frustration turns into success, it is appropriate to sing and dance out heartily, just like a tiger roars and a dragon exalts in triumph. Under the blue sky, there is naturally a direct way up to it, so it is just a matter of time before you achieve fame.
divination: You will have a clear and smooth prospect when you follow the given instructions closely, let go of what needs to go, stop when told to stop, go with the flow. Eventually there will be good results.
items: Face a difficult situation bravely, a crisis becomes a turning point.
Continue to work hard, it will become a great weapon.
Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. Poem has 通霄路 as printed (shiyi/explain use 云霄). en interpretation line 1 (sentence break) kept within one string; 'Sickness:  Safe' has a double space after the colon on the page (trimmed in value). '50 %' spacing kept as printed.
